changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql:
-- Rimozione associazioni alla funzione 19000 per i gruppi 4243 e 4240. DELETE FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.AUTH_GROUP_AUTH_FUNC WHERE CO_AUTH_FUNCTION_ID != 19000 AND CO_AUTH_GROUP_ID IN (4240, 4243);
-- Aggiunta associazione alla funzione 19000 per i gruppi informativa e dispositiva. INSERT INTO ${database.defaultSchemaName}.AUTH_GROUP_AUTH_FUNC (CO_AUTH_FUNCTION_ID, CO_AUTH_GROUP_ID) SELECT 19000, g.CO_ID FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.AUTH_GROUP g WHERE g.TE_NOME IN ('pagopa-dadgroup-smo-kpi-prn-informativa', 'pagopa-dadgroup-smo-kpi-prn-dispositiva') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.AUTH_GROUP_AUTH_FUNC x WHERE x.CO_AUTH_FUNCTION_ID = 19000 AND x.CO_AUTH_GROUP_ID = g.CO_ID );
changeSet.rollback:
-- Ripristino: rimuove le associazioni aggiunte. DELETE FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.AUTH_GROUP_AUTH_FUNC WHERE CO_AUTH_FUNCTION_ID = 19000 AND CO_AUTH_GROUP_ID IN ( SELECT CO_ID FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.AUTH_GROUP WHERE TE_NOME IN ('pagopa-dadgroup-smo-kpi-prn-informativa', 'pagopa-dadgroup-smo-kpi-prn-dispositiva') );
-- Ripristino: riaggiungi le associazioni ai gruppi 4240 e 4243. INSERT INTO ${database.defaultSchemaName}.AUTH_GROUP_AUTH_FUNC (CO_AUTH_FUNCTION_ID, CO_AUTH_GROUP_ID) SELECT 19000, g.CO_ID FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.AUTH_GROUP g WHERE g.CO_ID IN (4240, 4243) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${database.defaultSchemaName}.AUTH_GROUP_AUTH_FUNC x WHERE x.CO_AUTH_FUNCTION_ID = 19000 AND x.CO_AUTH_GROUP_ID = g.CO_ID );
